:Olver is definitely not Gaidal Cain, as Robert Jordan stated many times. He's far too old.
:
:Also... whoever stated that Gadren Grady is four years old, please find a source you can post to corroborate that. I don't remember ever hearing a specific age attributed to Gadren; just that he was very young. But he seems to have been an infant or toddler as of his first appearance at the Black Tower, so four seems unlikely to me.

"Swarthy" is a description of a person's skin-tone, not their build. I don't know the book's description of Gaidal's build, but even if the book describes his build as "swarthy" it is an incorrect usage of the word. [[Special:Contributions/87.212.154.17|87.212.154.17]] 20:24, April 23, 2013 (UTC)
